body:
Addressed in eca80ae00. The canonical approximationError minimum now uses the explicit decimal/double/float datatype union, and rootSystemRank uses xsd:nonNegativeInteger. The compiler preserves that union and the integer bounds in the derived validation surface.

Current-source checks pass: derive_qualified_numeric_data_ranges_retains_union_and_integer_bounds, and canonical_numeric_data_ranges_validate_the_generated_union. The latter exercises actual generated shapes with decimal/double/float positives, valid and negative-lexical integer values, string negatives, and absent required values. Authenticated whole-corpus and full-PR qualification remain open; these checks address this specific value-type gap.
